setup_commands: mkdir -p data outputs src tests docs
first_milestone_check: Given one learner profile and one learning objective, the system produces one activity and one feedback message.
validation_checks: Each activity maps to a specific learning objective.
Student progress output changes when learner inputs change.
Feedback explains the next step instead of only giving a score.
The dashboard or output separates learner, activity, progress, and feedback data.
common_errors: Creating activities that are not tied to learning objectives.
Treating feedback as a generic score instead of an actionable next step.
Hardcoding one learner instead of supporting multiple profiles.
Ignoring privacy and safety concerns around student data.
typical_portfolio_artifacts: demo screenshot or GIF of the learning activity flow
interview_talking_points: Explain how the system maps activities to learning objectives.
Explain how student progress changes the recommendation or feedback.
Explain how you avoided hardcoding one learner path.
Explain what data you would avoid collecting for student privacy.
demo_strategy: Show two learner profiles receiving different activities, progress summaries, or feedback for the same learning objective.
deployment_path: Lightweight web dashboard or API demo showing learner profile, activity recommendation, progress, and feedback.
test_strategy: Use fixtures for two learner profiles and assert the generated activity or feedback changes based on learner state.
